verdicts.reason: Both make the same mistakes. The wind-turbine icon, which is the hero image, has shrunk to a tiny speck. It sits squeezed into a top strip alongside the green, blue and red triangles, which are cut into small fragments. The headline is now huge and outranks the icon, the triangles that framed the corners are gone, and the thin diagonal lines float at random on the right. A's text is slightly larger and sits closer to the right edge, while B's is a bit smaller and slightly better spaced. Otherwise the two are effectively the same.
